1. SURFACE
Std Marlin/Prusa gcode. XYZE cartesian axes, mm units implied (no G20 inch cmd seen), G0/G1/G2/G3 moves, M486 obj-tracking (S id, A name). Two objects declared: "Embossed text", "Shape-Box". Surface reading: object label = literal printed text string.

2. CONTENT
Real convention differs on 2 points:

- **E mode**: surface looks like maybe-absolute E coord. Test: max E=15.928, 60761 G1 lines, X/Y span ~216x210mm (96-98% of MK4S 250x210 bed — full-size box). Absolute-cumulative E over that much toolpath would need thousands of mm filament, not 15.9. avg E/G1 = 0.00026mm — nonsensical for absolute. → confirms relative extrusion (M83), Prusa-profile default. Hypothesis "E absolute" falsified.
- **M486 A-label ≠ printed glyphs**: "AEmbossed text" is PrusaSlicer's exclude-object *name* field (usually STL/object name user typed in slicer, e.g. "Text" tool default name or literal string entered), not a decoded rendering of toolpath geometry. Actual visible characters depend on vector/font shape baked into the mesh — cannot be derived from this label alone.

CONTENT VERDICT: MISMATCH

3. MISREADINGS

- **Misreading A**: treat E column as absolute extruder position → total filament wrong by orders of magnitude, retraction detection (negative E) misfires. Evidence: E max 15.9 vs G1 count 60761 across near-full-bed geometry — falsified numerically above. Correct: relative (M83), each E value ≈ per-segment delta.
- **Misreading B**: assume printed text literally reads "Embossed text" cuz M486 label says so. Evidence: M486 `A` arg is slicer object-name metadata (exclude-object feature), independently settable by user, commonly just left as default/placeholder — not parsed from mesh glyphs. No glyph geometry given in this mechanical summary, so actual printed characters undetermined from this data.
- **Misreading C**: assume Y-min=-4 is part of printed object bbox. Evidence: MK4S usable bed Y ~0-210; negative Y typical of purge/prime line before print start, outside object. M555 bbox header (Y=2.994, H=203.855) confirms real object Y-range starts ~3, not -4 — the -4 line is extraneous (purge), not object geometry.
- **Misreading D**: assume inch units (G20) somewhere. Evidence: cmd freq table has no G20/G21 entries at all in top-15 despite G0-G3 present — mm is Marlin/Prusa power-on default, consistent w/ bed-scale coordinate values (X/Y in 0-250 range matches mm bed size, not inch).

Hypotheses tested numerically: E-absolute (falsified, avg 0.00026mm/line), E-relative (survives, matches Prusa M83 default + small per-line deltas), full-bed-object (survives: X/Y span 96-98% of 250x210 bed).
